provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: SETI rulebook (Czech Games Edition, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Assemble the main board from the planetary, solar system and tech boards
Shuffle the 5 alien species boards facedown; 2 random ones in the slots on the planetary board; box the rest unseen
steps.note: Alien cards and components stay in the box until discovered

steps.text: Solar system: the 3 discs and 4 sector boards in a random configuration forming 8 clear sectors
Shuffle the main deck; deal {n} cards faceup as the card row
Credit and energy tokens near the board
Fill each nearby star's data slot with data tokens; the rest nearby
The 4 gold scoring tiles beside the board, random side up
Neutral milestone markers above the 20- and 30-point spaces: {n}
For each of the 12 techs: shuffle its 4 tiles onto its space, technology side down, with a 2-point tile on top
Each player takes the pieces of a color; whoever last saw a UFO starts
Starting income card: 4 publicity, 4 credits, 3 energy and 5 cards
Turn one of your 5 cards into income (tuck it under the income card)
5 rounds; tucked income pays its bonus at once and again each round from round 2
The starting player takes the first turn; play is clockwise
